fields.title: Where variability is acceptable
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each scenario: is it acceptable, and how to restrict if not.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Generating a product description for a card
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Extracting weight and volume from supplier text
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — acceptable, but output goes through moderation before publishing. 2 — unacceptable: strict JSON, zero temperature, code check, fallback to manual handling if unparsed. 3 — unacceptable in content, acceptable in phrasing: fact from context, low temperature, source citation. 4 — acceptable and provides value, plus a 'more options' button. Technique: separate content variability from phrasing.
